My research applies data analysis and data mining methods to electrical power systems, with a
particular focus on power quality. The ongoing transition towards renewable energy sources
and electric vehicles is impacting electrical power systems, and network operators are
responding with extensive measurement campaigns that generate vast amounts of data. I develop
methods to efficiently analyze this data and extract insights
that help identify issues, optimize system performance, and improve the reliability of
electrical power systems.
